description: This file defines the ModuleService class, which provides CRUD operations and data handling for module beans within a SuiteCRM-based API. It manages retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting module records, as well as handling associated file uploads and relationships.

classes.name: ModuleService
classes.description: Provides API services for CRM modules, including retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and associated file handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ModuleService with required helpers and managers.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a single module record by ID with access control.

methods.name: getRecords
methods.description: Retrieves multiple module records with filtering, sorting, pagination, and email-related special handling.

methods.name: createRecord
methods.description: Creates a new module record, handling file uploads and permissions.

methods.name: updateRecord
methods.description: Updates an existing module record, including file uploads and permission checks.

methods.name: deleteRecord
methods.description: Marks a module record as deleted with access control.

methods.name: getDataResponse
methods.description: Generates a DataResponse object representing the module bean data.

methods.name: addFileToDocument
methods.description: Associates a file with a Document bean, saving file content securely.

methods.name: addFileToNote
methods.description: Associates a file with a Note bean, saving file content securely.

methods.name: processAttributes
methods.description: Processes attribute array to set properties on a bean and determine if a file is to be uploaded.

methods.name: setRecordUpdateParams
methods.description: Sets creation and modification metadata fields on a bean based on attributes.
